About S4

A passion for clothing. A calling for service.

S4 specializes in group fittings for corporate reward and recognition events, and for hospitality businesses.

Founded by Jonathan Schwimmer, whose experience across the fashion and hospitality industries spans more than twenty years, S4 aims to deliver exceptional, world-class experiences to you and your business.

Our core value is integrity — professional and personal. Not quite sure what we mean? Ask us about it.

What we do

We come to you — fabric books, buttons, and all.

Step 01

The visit

We arrive wherever you are with books of fabric and buttons, and decide together what range of customization to offer your group.

Step 02

The fitting

Measurements are taken for everyone you've invited. Each wearer customizes their garment within the range you've chosen — enough individuality that it feels like their own.

Step 03

The making

Then comes the hard part: waiting. Our process typically takes four to eight weeks from fitting to your door.

Step 04

The finish

Bodies can change over eight weeks. If a piece needs adjustment, we arrange alterations until it fits to your comfort.

What exactly is custom?

Three levels of tailor-made.

Level one

Made-to-measure

A garment you'd find on the rack, remade identically — but cut to your body's measurements.

Level two · Our specialty

Custom

Your personal choices — buttons, lapel width, pockets, fabric — built into a new garment unique to you, from a fit template S4 has created.

Level three

Full bespoke

Your entire body is measured and a pattern drafted from scratch. The slowest, most labor-intensive process — reflected in price and delivery time.

Where'd the name come from?

Staff four: supply & logistics.

Napoleon developed a method of organizing armies still in use by major militaries today. In that system, S-4 is the staff for supply and logistics — the people who kept everyone fed, supplied, and clothed for whatever lay ahead.

In addition, four intertwined S-words shape our company ethos.
Substance

Integrity

To us, integrity is being true to our beliefs, spreading peace through trade, service, and hospitality, and benefiting all we interact with — regardless of need, want, or agenda. Substance implies depth: something having more meaning than meets a surface scan.

Style

Near & dear

Style is something near and dear to us, even if a subjective matter.

Sophistication

In style & service

Sophistication in the style and service we provide will go a long way in strengthening the relationships we have with our clients, friends, and members.

Service

The highest calling

Service is one of the highest callings anyone can answer. To us it's simple: excellent service is about consideration — and everyone remembers exceptional service.
